title: Sea Plans Monee IPO to Revive Share Price

tickers.name: Sea Limited American Depositary Shares, each representing one Class A Ordinary Share

summary:
The operator of the Shopee e-commerce marketplace is launching Sea Cloud to provide AI-powered infrastructure to businesses globally. The Singapore internet giant is also preparing an initial public offering for Monee, its financial services arm, to accelerate its growth and diversify its revenue streams beyond retail and gaming.

These strategic moves are intended to reverse a decline in the company's stock price. By entering the enterprise cloud market, Sea will compete directly with existing providers such as Amazon and Alibaba Cloud.
